name: ChromaDust
description: Removes dust, hair and specks from scanned film. Put it above ChromaLab, on the film as scanned. Film: pick Black & white for black-and-white negatives (it leaves thin lines of the picture, such as wires and fur, that it would otherwise take for hairs). Scan file: pick Raw TIFF without a profile for a raw scan saved as TIFF (VueScan Raw, SilverFast HDR): the app reads such a file as sRGB, which makes picture highlights look as deep as dust. Sensitivity sets how sure it must be that a mark is dust. Detection scale: Half is experimental: on a large, soft scan (a flatbed at 3200 dpi) it finds wide hairs and is about three times faster, but it also takes thin dark lines of the picture (wires, cables, lettering); tick Show detected spots to see what it finds. Large marks (a fibre or speck wider than Max spot size): click Measure; it looks for them on the whole frame and the filter removes them too. Measure again after changing the crop.
author: nwh212
